note: Lolo NF campground beside Rock Creek (a blue-ribbon trout stream) among ponderosa pine and Douglas-fir, 11 mi south of I-90 exit 126 on Rock Creek Rd #102. Rock Creek Rd is narrow gravel above the pavement, so drive it slowly with a rig. Horses and pack animals not allowed. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page: confirmed $15/night (2 vehicles), first-come first-served, vault toilets and potable water; added the 2026 season May 1 - Sep 28. Cleared the derived 32-ft max (Allstays only; the FS states no length). Not stated: site count, stay limit, discounts (inherited). Alerts: nothing for Rock Creek Rd. Note trimmed of restated values and the Allstays length.
flags: Criteria problem (walk-in sites): The Dyrt's reviewers describe Norton as a walk-in campground - 'This 13 site campground has only designated parking areas, no pulling into a campsite. Those camping will need to walk their gear a short distance', 'Norton campground is not for the RV crowd' - and The Dyrt says 'RVs longer than 24 feet will not fit'. The Forest Service page gives no length and does not say whether sites are drive-in. Worth a satellite look; if the sites really are walk-in it fails the drive-in RV rule.

Phone: the entry's 406-329-3750 is the Lolo NF Supervisor's Office; the page's district contact is Missoula Ranger Station 406-329-3814 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/norton-campground).
